passages.name: Line 1
passages.text:
Wilfred: Hey Meone! Wait up! Stop running off, it is too dangerous for a cat like you!

[[Line 2]]

passages.name: Line 3
passages.text:
Wilfred: Huh? Meone? Did you step on something?
[[Line 4]]

passages.name: Line 5
passages.text:
Wilfred: Oh Meone for the love of- AAAH!
[[Line 6]]

passages.name: Line 6
passages.text:
Ackergaul: My my, that is convenient. I was looking all over for this vile furball everywhere.
[[Line 7]]

passages.name: Line 7
passages.text:
Wilfred: Wait... you were looking for Meone!? Why was Meone here in the first place!?
[[Line 8]]

passages.name: Line 10
passages.text:
Ackergaul: Didn't your father ever tell you to mind your business?
[[Line 11]]

passages.name: Line 11
passages.text:
Wilfred: Huh!? Do you think my father would let you lock me up like this?
[[Line 12]]

passages.name: Line 12
passages.text:
Ackergaul: I honestly do not think he would care much for your state. 
[[Line 13]]

passages.name: Line 13
passages.text:
Ackergaul: Nor do I, to be frank. A new shipment has come from Beatrix, I must get to work
[[Line 14]]

passages.name: Line 14
passages.text:
Wilfred: Hey! Get back here! I'm not done asking questions!
[[Line 15]]
